{{Quote|Everything I did, I did for the Rebellion. And every time I walked away from something I wanted to forget, I told myself it was for a cause I believed in. A cause that was worth it. Without that, we're lost. Everything we've done would have been for nothing. I couldn't face myself if I gave up now.|Cassian Andor vows to accompany Jyn Erso to Scarif|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
'''Cassian Jeron Andor''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Intelligence officer|operative]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who was remembered as a hero after his [[Death|sacrifice]] to secure the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Death Star plans]] at the [[Battle of Scarif]]. An accomplished [[spy]] and [[assassin]], Andor was well-respected within the Rebellion and was trusted with leading [[Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service|Alliance Intelligence]] missions by [[Alliance High Command]].

Originally a [[Kenari (people)|Kenari]] boy named '''Kassa''', the human was rescued by [[smuggler]]s [[Clem Andor|Clem]] and [[Maarva Carassi Andor]] after a [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] [[Starship|vessel]] had crashed on his [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[homeworld]] of [[Kenari]] prior to the [[Clone Wars]]. Thereafter, the boy was named Cassian Andor, given a forged identity as an individual [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[planet]] [[Fest]], and settled with his [[Andor family|adopted family]], including the [[droid]] [[B2EMO]], on the [[Free Trade sector]] world [[Ferrix]]. After the execution of his adopted father, Andor came into conflict with Imperial authorities. Before officially joining the Rebellion, he was contacted by the leader of the [[Axis network]], [[Luthen Rael]], and participated in the [[Aldhani heist]]. For a brief period of time, using his share of the money stolen from Aldhani, he lived as a tourist on the planet [[Niamos]] using the alias '''Keef Girgo''', before being arrested and becoming a prisoner in the [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex]]. Upon [[Narkina 5 prison escape|breaking out]], Andor received news that Maarva had passed away, and returned to [[Ferrix]], where, following a [[Ferrix Riot|riot]] induced by his mother's final recorded message, Andor eventually joined Rael's network and made his way into the [[Galactic Civil War|war]] against the Empire. During his time in the Rebellion, Andor worked as a skilled spy, assassin, [[Rebel trooper|soldier]], and [[Rebel pilot|pilot]], operating many rebel missions with aliases such as '''Willix''', '''Aach''', '''Joreth Sward''', '''Varian Skye,''' '''Ronni Googe,''' '''Clem''', and the [[Fulcrum|codename]] '''Fulcrum'''.

By [[1 BBY]], Andor was a [[captain]] for Alliance Intelligence and was assigned to assist in [[Operation Fracture]]: to extract Imperial scientist [[Galen Walton Erso]], responsible for the development of a secret [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Imperial "planet-killer" superweapon]]. Erso had tasked cargo pilot [[Bodhi Rook]] with delivering a message about the [[Superweapon|weapon]] to renegade rebel leader [[Saw Gerrera]] on the [[moon]] [[Jedha]]. Andor, alongside his droid companion, [[K-2SO]], and Galen's daughter [[Jyn Erso]], traveled to [[Jedha City]] and made acquaintances with two local [[Guardians of the Whills]]: [[Chirrut Îmwe]] and [[Baze Malbus]]. Together, they recovered Rook from Gerrera's [[Catacombs of Cadera|enclave]] of rebel [[Partisans]], and Jyn Erso watched her father's [[Hologram|holographic]] message about the [[Weapon|superweapon]]—named the [[Death Star]]. After narrowly escaping the test firing of the Death Star on Jedha, the crew traveled to the planet [[Eadu]], where Galen Erso was stationed at an [[Eadu Energy Conversion Laboratory|Imperial laboratory]]. Andor was secretly instructed by Alliance Intelligence's [[General]] [[Davits Draven]] to [[Mission to Eadu|assassinate]] Galen Erso, and to that end, the rebel operative kept his intentions to himself and lied to Jyn Erso that they would retrieve her father.

However, Andor was conflicted as Jyn Erso claimed that her father, per the message she received, was deceiving his Imperial superiors and had installed a fatal flaw within the Death Star—one that the rebels could exploit to utterly obliterate the weapon. Andor hesitated while Galen Erso was within his [[sniper rifle]]'s [[scope]]s, and rebel reinforcements bombed the Imperial facility, killing Jyn's father. After Andor pulled Jyn Erso away from the ruined facility and their crew hastily fled aboard a stolen [[SW-0608|Imperial transport]], the rebels gathered to discuss the threat of the Death Star at their [[Great Temple|hidden fortress]] on the moon [[Yavin 4]]. When Alliance High Command rejected Jyn Erso's plea to steal the Death Star plans from an [[Imperial Center of Military Research|Imperial installation]] on [[Scarif]], Andor assembled a team of soldiers willing to act of their own accord, having been inspired by Erso's assertion that rebellions were built on hope and determination against all odds.

The rebel team, designated [[Rogue One]], was comprised of Andor, Erso, K-2SO, Rook, Îmwe, Malbus, and [[Sergeant]] [[Ruescott Melshi]], and aimed to steal the plans themselves. Andor, Erso, and K-2SO snuck into the Scarif base's [[Citadel Tower]] [[Scarif vault|vault]], while Melshi [[Commanding officer|led]] the bulk of their forces to cause chaos around the base by planting [[detonator]]s and engaging the [[Scarif Deployment|Imperial garrison]]. Upon the arrival of the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]] in Scarif's [[orbit]], Andor and Rogue One requested the [[fleet]] to disrupt the [[planetary shield]] so that they could beam the Death Star plans to the fleet. Although the rebels succeeded in transmitting the plans, the Death Star itself came to Scarif and fired upon the Imperial base: Cassian Andor and Jyn Erso embraced each other on the shores of Scarif in their last moments, satisfied that Jyn's father would be proud. Thanks to Rogue One's efforts, the Rebellion used the plans to identify the [[Thermal exhaust port|weak point]] planted by Galen Erso, and the Death Star was soon [[Battle of Yavin|destroyed]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
====Kassa of Kenari====
{{Quote|Suddenly the Rebellion is real for you? Some of us ''live'' it. I've been in this fight since I was ''six years old''! You're not the only one who lost everything. Some of us just decided to do something about it.|Cassian Andor to Jyn Erso|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
[[File:YoungKassa.png|thumb|left|300px|Young Kassa on Kenari]]
A [[human]] [[Gender|male]], Kassa was [[Reproduction|born]]<ref name="Episode 1" /> on the [[planet]]<ref name="Kenari Databank">{{Databank|kenari|Kenari}}</ref> [[Kenari]]<ref name="Episode 1" /> in [[33 BBY]]<ref name="birthyear" /> in the later years of the [[Galactic Republic]], prior to the start of the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="Ep3EG">{{SW|url=series/andor/andor-season-1-episode-3-episode-guide|text="Reckoning" Episode Guide | Andor}}</ref> He lost his [[Cassian Jeron Andor's mother|mother]] at a tender age. There was little else in Kassa's life aside from constant battle.<ref name="Helmet Collection 56" /> However, the many struggles he faced were largely undocumented. According to what he personally confirmed, he had fought as a revolutionary since he was only six [[Standard year|years]] old.<ref name="From the Shadows" /> After managing to survive the [[mining]] efforts—which had been carried out by groups like the Republic and commercial interests—that exploited Kenari and left the world toxic,<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> Kassa made a life for himself as part of a [[Kenari Village|small village]] [[Alpha (Kenari)|tribe]] of youths alongside his little sister [[Kerri]],<ref name="Episode 1" /> living in the [[Kenari Forest|forest]] and surveying deforested ruins that were caused by the massive [[mining]] operations<ref name="Ep2EG">{{SW|url=series/andor/andor-season-1-episode-2-episode-guide|text="That Would Be Me" Episode Guide | Andor}}</ref> that had left children such as himself the only survivors on the planet.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

At the age of nine years old,<ref name="Cassian DB">{{Databank|cassian-andor|Cassian Andor}}</ref> when a Republic<ref name="217 Kassa">{{InsiderCite|217|Kassa (article)}}</ref> [[transpo corsair]] crashed near his village,<ref name="Ep3EG" /> Kassa wished to join the party of fellow youths to [[Exploratory mission to investigate a downed craft|investigate]] the wreckage. While some of Kassa's peers had wanted to exclude the boy, their [[Unidentified Alpha leader|group leader]] personally allowed him to don their camouflage markings and join their party. Each armed with a [[blowgun]], the Kenari trekked through the jungles and approached the crash site.<ref name="Episode 1" /> After their group leader was [[Death|killed]] by the lone survivor of the [[transport]] with [[blaster]] fire—technology alien to the Kenari—the youths promptly sullied the crash victim with [[poison dart]]s and carried their late leader's body away.<ref name="Episode 2">{{Andor|That Would Be Me}}</ref> A shocked Kassa stayed behind and went inside the [[Starship|ship]], where he lashed out his frustrations at the alien technology that lined the vessel's walls. Suddenly, a trio<ref name="Episode 3" /> of [[scavenger]]s—[[Maarva Carassi Andor|Maarva Andor]], her [[Marriage|husband]] [[Clem Andor|Clem]],<ref name="Clem DB">{{Databank|clem-andor|Clem Andor}}</ref> and their droid [[B2EMO]]—entered the ship in search of salvageable technology and came face-to-face with Kassa.<ref name="Episode 3" />

[[File:MaarvaSavesAndor.png|thumb|330px|Maarva Andor rescues Kassa from Kenari.]]
Subsequently, he was taken offworld and adopted by Maarva, who did not want him to be in danger by those who would come for it next.<ref name="Episode 3" /> The Republic ship bore a symbol closely related to the eventual [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="Ep3EG" /> which waged the Clone Wars against the Republic later in [[22 BBY]] until [[19 BBY]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> Moving to the<ref name="Ep3EG" /> planet<ref name="Nobody's Listening!">{{Andor|Nobody's Listening!}}</ref> [[Ferrix]] with his new adoptive [[parent]]s,<ref name="Ep3EG" /> Kassa then took on the name Cassian Jeron Andor, with official records stating his origin to be the<ref name="Episode 2" /> planet<ref name="Visual Guide" /> [[Fest]].<ref name="Episode 2" /> While questions about the truth of that claim did emerge, the haze caused by covert operations and war left it plausible and kept the truth hidden. Like many other rebels of his generation, conflict was a constant throughout Andor's life.<ref name="From the Shadows">{{InsiderCite|212|From the Shadows: The Dangerous Life of a Rebel Agent}}</ref> Although he left his home planet of Kenari behind, he never forgot about his sister.<ref name="217 Kassa" />

====Childhood on Ferrix====
{{Quote|Well, they'd hang me, wouldn't they? Take me up Rix Road and hang me in the square. Wouldn't be the first time, would it? Isn't that where they hung your father?|Luthen Rael, to Cassian Andor, regarding the Empire and Clem Andor|<ref name="Episode 3" />}}
[[File:Andor-Clones-on-Ferrix.png|left|thumb|300x300px|During Cassian's youth, his father Clem Andor was killed by the Galactic Empire.]]
Andor's [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] file,<ref name="Cassian Andor 101">{{SW|url=news/cassian-andor-101-the-story-of-a-rebel|text=Cassian Andor 101: The Story of a Rebel|nolive=1}}</ref> something that would be of questionable accuracy because of the haze of war and covert missions,<ref name="From the Shadows" /> made several allegations about his life during the Clone Wars. It alleged that<ref name="Cassian Andor 101" /> his [[Cassian Jeron Andor's father|birth father]] was [[Death|killed]] at the [[Carida Academy]] in a [[Anti-military protest at the Carida Academy|protest]] against the expansion of [[Republic Military|Republic militarism]]<ref name="Visual Guide" /> during the Clone Wars.<ref name="Rogue Graphic Novel">[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]]</ref> The file further alleged that<ref name="Cassian Andor 101" /> Andor joined an [[Outer Rim Territories insurrectionist cell|insurrectionist cell]] backed by the Confederacy in the wilds of the [[Outer Rim Territories]] and fought against the Galactic Republic. While he never became a formal Separatist, Andor saw combat experience in the cell as a child [[soldier]].<ref name="Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> While he did not have specific duties during his time as a child soldier, limiting his experience<ref name="Helmet Collection 56" /> to tossing rocks and bottles at Republic [[walker]]s and [[clone trooper]]s,<ref name="Visual Guide" /> his life remained one full of conflict.<ref name="Helmet Collection 56" /> Whether it was true or not,<ref name="Cassian Andor 101" /> Andor would ultimately continue to live on Ferrix with his adoptive parents even as<ref name="Episode 7">{{Andor|Announcement}}</ref> the war ended in [[19 BBY]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> with the defeat of the Confederacy.<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref> Andor at one point told [[Arvel Skeen]] that,<ref name="Episode 5" /> during his turbulent childhood on Ferrix,<ref name="Dawn of Rebellion" /> he spent three years in a youth center on [[Sipo]], beginning at the age of thirteen. It was there that he learned about [[prison]] tattoos, including [[Krayt Head]] and [[By The Hand]] tattoos.<ref name="Episode 5" />

The Republic, meanwhile, was [[Proclamation of the New Order|restructured]] into the [[Galactic Empire]] under [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], who became the state's [[Galactic Emperor]].<ref name="Episode III" /> In 19 BBY,<ref name="Dawn Guide">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> the Empire moved to assert control over Ferrix, deploying a formation of [[clone stormtrooper]]s under an [[Unidentified Imperial officer (Ferrix)|Imperial officer]]. Andor and Clem stood with many other members of their community as the clones marched down [[Rix Road]] through [[Ferrix City]], with Clem urging the boy to remain calm and wait for the Imperials to leave. When a few citizens began to protest and throw rocks at the soldiers, Andor was ordered by Clem to not intervene while he went to diffuse the situation. The [[Imperial officer|officer]], however, assumed Clem was part of the demonstration, leaving Andor to watch as a blaster was aimed at his adoptive father. Clem was taken away by the Imperials and [[Hanging|hanged]] for his supposed defiance at Rix Road.<ref name="Episode 7" />

Enraged at the execution of his father, Andor traveled to Rix Road while his father's body still hung to confront four [[Cloning|clone]] [[stormtrooper]]s with a [[baton]].<ref name="Episode 7" /> At some point, Andor spent time with anarchist groups that defied the Empire.<ref name="Visual Guide" /> Alongside the destruction of Imperial property, Andor had a charge for attacking an Imperial soldier on his record.<ref name="Episode 2" /> Andor claimed that he was forced to [[Mimban Campaign|fight]] for the Empire on the [[swamp]]world [[Mimban]] after leaving [[prison]] when he was sixteen years old, although when he said this to [[Luthen Rael]] after they met<ref name="Episode 4" /> in [[5 BBY]],<ref name="5 BBY Date">{{AndorDate|104}}</ref> Rael retorted by saying that he had only spent six months on Mimban and served as a [[Chef|cook]], before deserting.<ref name="Episode 4" /> Andor eventually entered a relationship with [[salvage yard]] owner [[Bix Caleen]],<ref name="Episode 7" /> but their relationship became broken due to Andor's actions.<ref name="ProductionBrief 1">{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess#!asset/gppr5wpqgb4t74974f8s|text=ANDOR Production Brief V3 FINAL 8-04-22|date=2022-08-04}}</ref>

===Fomenting dissent===
====Trip to Morlana One====
{{Quote|What are you? Seriously. Boyfriend? Husband?''"<br />"''I'm looking for my sister.|A hostess and Cassian Andor|<ref name="Episode 1" />}}
[[File:Into_the_brothel.png|thumb|330px|Andor enters a brothel]]
By 5 BBY, Andor lived with Maarva and B2EMO in a [[Andor household|house]] on Ferrix.<ref name="Episode 1" /> At one point, he stole an [[Imperial N-S9 Starpath Unit]] from the Empire from the [[Steergard Naval Yard|Imperial Naval Base]] on [[Steergard]].<ref name="Episode 3" /> Despite having a new family, Andor did not forget about his long-lost sister and had begun<ref name="Episode 1" /> a [[Search for Kerri|galaxy-wide search]]<ref name="On Program">{{InsiderCite|220|On Program}}</ref> for her. After learning of a girl from Kenari working at a [[Leisure Zone brothel|brothel]] on [[Morlana One]], he traveled to the planet's [[Leisure Zone]] in search of her. Upon entering, he ordered a drink at the bar and was soon approached by a [[Unidentified brothel hostess|hostess]], which angered two other patrons who had not been served yet. The hostess dismissed them and turned her attention back to Andor. He calmly refused her services and asked her if there was in fact a girl from Kenari working there. When the woman left to check, the two men began making snide remarks at Andor. Upon the hostess returning, Andor learned that a girl from Kenari had indeed been working there, but had left several [[Standard month|months]] earlier. Andor asked for her name and if she knew where the girl had gone, whispering that he was searching for his sister when the hostess inquired about his relation to the girl. She then said that people came and went all the time and that he should leave. Andor asked if she knew the girl's name, but the hostess replied that nobody used their real names at the establishment.<ref name="Episode 1" />

As Andor walked through the rain of Morlana One back to his ship, the two men from the brothel, who were guards for the [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]] [[Pre-Mor Authority Security Forces|enforcement division]], followed him, stopping him from returning to his ship. When Andor said that he had three hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] in his pocket and did not want any trouble, the first man, [[Kravas Drezzer]], smiled and said that three hundred was exactly the amount owed for illegally parking his ship past the causeway. He then held his blaster to Andor's head while his compatriot, [[Verlo Skiff]], rummaged in his coat to take his credits. It was then that Andor sprung into action, headbutting Skiff and brawling with Drezzer, wrestling his blaster away and aiming it at the man. On his knees, Drezzer realized that Skiff was not breathing and told Andor that he had killed him. He then begged for his life, offering to help corroborate a story that would excuse Andor of murder. However, Andor decided to kill Drezzer before fleeing back to his ship and returning to Ferrix.<ref name="Episode 1" />

====Back on Ferrix====
{{Quote|Wouldn't you rather give it all at once, to something real?|Luthen Rael, to Andor|<ref name="Episode 4" />}}
[[File:Andor-NewsSlider.jpg|thumb|left|330px|Andor on Ferrix]]
Returning to Ferrix, Andor first stopped at his hideout, which was a downed ship located in a junkyard outside the city. He was later awakened by B2EMO. As he ate, he inquired if anyone had come by the house looking for him, to which B2EMO responded that his friend [[Brasso]] had. He then asked B2EMO to help him lie and form a cover story for his whereabouts the previous night. When the droid agreed, Andor hustled to the mines, where he met Brasso after he returned from his shift. After Brasso inquired as to where Andor had been the previous night, Andor launched into a false account of the events, telling Brasso to help cover for him. Two two agreed to a story that the two had wanted to go out drinking, and after deciding against going to [[Cavo's]], ended up falling asleep at Brasso's home with a bottle of [[Nog (beverage)|nog]]. Afterward, Andor traveled to<ref name="Episode 1" /> [[Caleen Salyard]]<ref name="Ep1EG">{{SW|url=series/andor/andor-season-1-episode-1-episode-guide|text="Kassa" Episode Guide | Andor}}</ref> to meet with his friend [[Bix Caleen]]. He told her of the Starpath unit he had acquired, knowing she had a contact who would want to buy the item. Caleen begrudgingly agreed to contact the buyer on his behalf.<ref name="Episode 1" />

Looking to use the money to leave Ferrix, he arranged a meeting with the buyer, a rebel named [[Luthen Rael]]. Wanting to buy the unit but being more interested in Andor's skills, Rael tried to recruit Andor to his growing efforts. When Rael revealed that he knew a lot of information about Andor, including about his father's death, Andor became angry and pulled his blaster on the man, but before their conflict could escalate, the two were [[Ambush on Ferrix|attacked]] by the [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]]. Andor got grazed in the shoulder by a blaster shot. Working together, the pair managed to escape back to town, commandeer a speeder, travel to Rael's ship, and leave Ferrix.<ref name="Episode 3" />

====Rebel mission on Aldhani====
{{Quote|What would we be stealing?''"<br />"''A quarterly payroll for an entire Imperial sector.|Andor questioning Rael|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}}</ref>}}
Later, Rael tried to convince Andor to join his nascent rebellious movement, but Andor insisted that, while despising the Empire, he only sought his own freedom and comfort. Thus, Andor agreed to participate in a [[Aldhani heist|mission on Aldhani]] for a reward of 200,000 Imperial credits. Adopting the alias "Clem," the name of [[Clem Andor|his adoptive father]], he shaved off his facial [[hair]] and met with the rebel [[Vel Sartha]]. Rael introduced Andor to Sartha and told her that she had to incorporate him into her [[Aldhani rebel infiltration team|team]]. Sartha was displeased, but Rael told her that he would call her operation off if she did not accept. He then told her to lie to the others and say that Andor had always been supposed to join them. Rael then departed, leaving Andor and Sartha to return to the [[Vel Sartha's camp|rebel camp]]. During their trip, Sartha told Andor not to mention Rael to any of the others.<ref name="Episode 4" />

Andor arrived at the team's camp and was greeted with suspicion by the rest of the team. The rebels [[Arvel Skeen]] and [[Taramyn Barcona]] were angered by the addition, with the former regarding Andor with a particular scorn. Andor had his wound treated by [[Cinta Kaz]] and later spoke with [[Karis Nemik]], who was much more amicable than the others.<ref name="Episode 4" /> The evening before the operation, Andor was briefed on the plan, which was to infiltrate the [[Aldhani dam]], steal a [[Max-7 Rono box freighter]], and load the Imperial payroll onto the ship before flying away. Andor was confused by certain elements of the plan and eventually realized that none of the other rebels were familiar with the specific freighter and did not know how to fly it. Andor demanded to fly it due to their unfamiliarity, and although she initially objected, Sartha agreed to let him fly.<ref name="Episode 5" />

Andor continued to learn details about the plan and learned that he, Barcona, Nemik, and Skeen would be impersonating [[Imperial Army trooper]]s under the command of [[Lieutenant]] [[Gorn]], an Imperial double-agent who the team was in league with. He inquired as to what Sartha and Kaz would be doing, but got no response. As the four men drilled, Andor suggested that Barcona and Skeen switch sides, and although Barcona reacted with hostility, Sartha stopped him and prompted Andor to explain why he had suggested it. Andor explained wanting Skeen on the opposite side due to his dominant left hand, and Sartha accepted the suggestion.<ref name="Episode 5" />

[[File:TheEye-AndorS1E6.png|thumb|330px|Andor and the rest of the crew infiltrating the Imperial Outpost on Aldhani]]
The crew executed the plan soon after, taking the [[Aldhani Garrison]] [[commandant]] [[Jayhold Beehaz]] and his [[Jayhold Beehaz's family|family]] hostage to enter the vault and steal the Imperial payroll. To escape the garrison, Andor flew the Max-7 Rono freighter, piloting the ship through the celestial event known as the [[Eye of Aldhani]] in order to flee an assignment of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] deployed to intercept them. During the escape, [[Karis Nemik]] was crushed by a payload of credits, critically injured, he continued to provide basic directions to Andor who piloted the freighter. After escaping the planet, Skeen and Sartha commanded him to change course to the remote nearby moon of [[Frezno]] to tend to Nemik's injuries. While [[Quadpaw]] operated on Nemik in a medical establishment, outside, Skeen offered Andor in his plan on bailing out on his crewmates and split the entire payroll for themselves after fleeing towards a nearby moon via the freighter. Andor, disgusted and deciding to stay committed to the cause, immediately shot Skeen dead. Later entering the establishment and holding Quadpaw and Sartha at blasterpoint Andor announced Skeen's death, and briefed on the man's planned betrayal of the crew as well as confirming his own share of the credits, some of which Andor intended to spend on purchasing Quadpaw's ship in his barn to return to Ferrix. Before leaving, Sartha gave Andor [[The Trail of Political Consciousness|Nemik's manifesto]].<ref name="Episode 6">{{Andor|The Eye}}</ref>

====Return to Ferrix====
{{Quote|I got lucky. I scored. I've got enough credits to get us anywhere. We're gonna clear out. Leave this mess behind.|Andor to Maarva|<ref name="Episode 7" />}}
After leaving Frezno, Andor returned to Ferrix to find it under [[Ferrix occupation|Imperial occupation]]. He hoped to convince Maarva and B2EMO to leave Ferrix for a fresh start elsewhere to evade Imperial rule using his share of the payroll. However, Maarva refused, having been inspired by the news on the Aldhani heist to join the rebellion. Andor also encountered Caleen, injured when she hit a wall while being held captive previously. He gave her twelve thousand credits for Caleen to pay off the debt he owed to people.<ref name="Episode 7" />

====Trouble on Niamos====
{{Quote|Six years.''"<br />"''Six years? No. Don't, wait. I didn't do anything, I'm just a tourist!|Andor being sentenced to prison in court.|<ref name="Episode 7" />}}
Despite his efforts of convincing Maarva to join him, Andor left Ferrix alone and traveled to [[Niamos]],<ref name="Episode 7" /> a tropical world that had once been a popular site for fugitives who needed to lie low but since had fallen under [[Occupation of Niamos|Imperial occupation]].<ref name="Niamos Databank">{{Databank|niamos|Niamos}}</ref> There, he went under the alias Keef Girgo and stayed in a [[Niamos Hotel|hotel]] with the woman [[Windi]]. After a run-in with a [[Coastal defender stormtrooper|shoretrooper]], who accused him of being involved in anti-Imperial activity, Andor was arrested and brought to the [[Niamos Courthouse]]. Waiting in a long line of citizens waiting to be heard by a [[Unidentified judge|judge]] and [[Unidentified prosecutor|prosecutor]]. Under the Empire's recently enacted [[Public Order Resentencing Directive]], a measure implemented due to the Aldhani heist, Andor was sentenced to six years in prison on [[Narkina 5]] and given no chance to protest.<ref name="Episode 7" />

====Imprisonment on Narkina 5====
{{Quote|I would rather die trying to take them down than die giving them what they want.|Andor to Loy|<ref name="Episode 10">{{Andor|One Way Out}}</ref>}}
[[File:VeemossDeath.png|left|thumb|300x300px|Andor was imprisoned on Narkina 5]]
Andor was incarcerated in [[Imperial factory facility]] part of the [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex]] on Narkina 5 and was assigned to [[Unit Five-Two-D]]'s [[Table Five]], consisting of six other inmates who constructed Imperial machinery<ref name="Episode 10" /> known as the [[EP-N5 fastener]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> although Andor himself never learned of the machinery's name nor purpose.<ref name="RiseFall">''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''</ref> Each of the tables were put in competition with each other and supervised by a [[floor manager]], the prisoner [[Kino Loy]]. Across day shifts, Andor formed bonds with fellow inmates, particularly those of his own table. Whenever Andor had thoughts of beginning an uprising, he was shut down by Loy, who preferred to finish his sentence which was nearing completion. Despite this, Andor and another teammate of his level, [[Birnok]], conspired to disable the [[Tunqstoid steel]]-charged flooring to enable the chance of an uprising. Their sabotage involved gradually cutting a water supply tube with a make-shift knife across shifts. When Andor and Loy learned of prisoners being re-sentenced instead of set free at the end of their sentence,<ref name="Episode 10" /> they led a successful [[Narkina 5 prison escape|uprising]] on the facility and escaped by swimming across the lake onto nearby land.<ref name="Episode 11" />

When Andor and fellow prisoner [[Ruescott Melshi|Melshi]] reached land, they ran and climbed away to evade incoming patrols. After successfully evading them, the two conspired to steal a distant parked [[TUG-b13|quadjumper]] guarded by two fisherman, [[Dewi Pamular]] and [[Freedi Pamular]]. Melshi attempted to steal the ship, which led to him and Andor being caught in a net trap. Despite this, the two were later freed by the fisherman, who were sympathetic to their plight, and agreed to drop them back on Niamos.<ref name="Episode 11">{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}}</ref>

====Return to Niamos====
{{Quote|We need to split up. Double our chances. One of us has to make it. People have to know what's going on.|Melshi to Andor|<ref name="Episode 11" />}}
[[File:Melshi-Cassian-Niamos-DoF.png|thumb|right|330px|Melshi and Andor before parting ways]]
After arriving on Niamos, Andor retrieved his case containing his personal belongings from his previous hotel room and contacted [[Xanwan]] on Ferrix to ask him to pass on his assurances to [[Maarva Carassi Andor|Maarva]]. Xanwan, shocked that Andor was unaware, informed him that she had recently passed away. Devastated, he silently grieved her death watching the sun set on the coastside, though he did not tell Melshi. After Melshi wondered whether they were the only ones who escaped, Andor gave Melshi a [[AD-616K6KA|pistol]] and the two split up to convey the story of their imprisonment at the Narkinian facility to others.<ref name="Episode 11" />

====Saving Bix and joining the Rebellion====
{{Quote|What game is this?''"<br />"''No game. Kill me. Or take me in.|Rael to Andor|<ref name="Episode 12" />}}
After returning again on [[Ferrix]] to attend his mother's funeral, Andor learned Caleen was captured by Imperials. After [[Pegla]], a local [[Zorby's Western Shiplot|shiplot]] employee, arranged for Andor to meet with Brasso in an underground tunnel, he made the decision to rescue her from captivity. As a [[Ferrix Riot|riot]] erupted outside during Maarva's funeral, Andor navigated his way through the hotel-turned-prison and rescued Caleen from her cell. Escorting her out, they join Pegla who helped Brasso prepare a shift for take-off to transport [[Wilmon Paak|Wilmon]] away from Ferrix. Cassian bids B2EMO, Caleen, Pegla, and Wilmon farewell and promised to meet with them again later on.<ref name="Episode 12" />

Later as Rael returned to his ship, he discovered Andor who was waiting for him, offering his blaster. Andor offered Rael to end his life then and there for how much of a nuisance he became for him, or to spare him and take him in as he seeks to join the fight against the Empire. Rael, smiling, accepted his offer,<ref name="Episode 12" /> bringing Andor into his rebel network<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and the<ref name="CelebrationCard">{{Topps|set=2023 Star Wars Galaxy Star Wars Celebration Europe 2023|cardname=Cassian Andor|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/360943/cid/21303521/2023-Star-Wars-Galaxy-Star-Wars-Celebration-Europe-2023--40-Cassian-Andor}}</ref> currently-informal<ref name="Secret Cargo">{{Rebels|Secret Cargo}}</ref> [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="CelebrationCard" />

===Early Rebellion===
====Theft of the Avenger====
Andor joined the early Rebellion<ref name="Helmet Collection 56" /> as a member of Luthen Rael's Axis network. In his capacity as a rebel agent, Andor could be deployed to carry out missions and meet with Rael's clients, such as the rebel leader [[Maya Pei]]. In the year following the Ferrix uprising, Andor would also re-establish a degree of contact with Brasso, B2EMO, Caleen, and Wilmon Paak, who had taken up life on the farming world [[Mina-Rau]] as undocumented workers. In [[4 BBY]], a year after the Ferrix conflict, Andor agreed to a mission to steal<ref name="OYL">{{Andor|One Year Later}}</ref> a prototype Imperial starfighter known as the [[TIE Avenger prototype|TIE Avenger]]<ref name="Avenger">{{Databank|tie-avenger-prototype|TIE Avenger prototype}}</ref> from the [[Sienar Fleet Systems]]-controlled<ref name="OYL" /> planet [[Sienar TF73]].<ref name="SienarTest">{{Databank|sienar-test-facility|Sienar Test Facility}}</ref> Leaving his [[Breon HOY-39 Dayvan]] on<ref name="OYL" /> the Outer Rim moon<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> [[Yavin 4]] with his [[Bryar pistol]] aboard,<ref name="Sagrona">{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}}</ref> Andor departed for 73, leaving with the understanding that another pilot, [[Porko]], would take the Avenger forward once he returned to Yavin.<ref name="OYL" />

Wearing the garb of a [[Sienar test pilot]],<ref name="SienarTestPilot">{{Amazon|url=STAR-WARS-G1553-SW-Whisk/dp/B0D94YBT8S|text=STAR WARS The Black Series Cassian Andor (Sienar Test Pilot), Andor Premium Collectible 6 Inch Action Figure}}</ref> Andor infiltrated [[Sienar Test Facility 73]] and waited for the rebellion's contact in the base,<ref name="OYL" /> a Sienar worker named [[Niya]],<ref name="NiyaDB">{{Databank|niya|Niya}}</ref> in an empty cafeteria at night. He waited by a window when Niya approached him and told him the starfighter was ready for a test drive and the password was [[Kafrene system|Kafrene]]. Andor asked for the key, and Niya explained they had to wait for her supervisor to leave as he did not stay late. She suggested a cover story of them flirting, and was nervous about the operation, but Cassian reassured her. Niya admitted to having had fun at the villa and her fear of change; Andor told her she was brave. Andor then watched as Niya lied to another colleague who thought that Andor was cute. Niya continued to be afraid of dying and the mission not meaning anything, so Andor reassured her again and said she made the correct decision.<ref name="OYL" />

After giving Niya a 20 minute head start, Andor made his way to the hanger unobstructed and boarded the Avenger. However, being unfamiliar with the starfighter's unusual controls, he accidentally launched himself in reverse, setting off the alarm and forcing the hanger doors to close. He struggled to move the Avenger towards the exit, instead firing the rotary blaster cannons wildly and colliding with the ceiling. As a stormtrooper squad arrived and opened fire on the rogue starfighter, Andor resorted to firing on them. He then swerved around and narrowly evaded a rocket fired by a [[Unidentified range trooper|ranger trooper]]. As his opponent began reloading his weapon, he attempted to fire the underbelly heavy laser cannon, resulting in the trooper's disintegration, blowing a hole in the door in the process. Andor then repeated the process, creating a large enough opening for him to accelerate into the outside and skid down a frozen slope. The starfighter briefly lost power upon coming to a stop, before Andor evaded two incoming missiles and dove into the canyon with two [[TIE/ad v1]]s in pursuit. After a brief chase while repeatedly colliding with the canyon walls, he managed to collapse a tunnel with a spread of torpedoes, crushing his pursuers, allowing him to flee 73.<ref name="OYL" />

====Prisoner on Yavin====
Andor traveled back to Yavin and landed back at his rendezvous point where he left his Breon HOY-39. Observing no sign of Porko, Andor exited the starfighter to investigate, only to be ambushed by a group of 15 humans, who assume him to be Imperial because of his uniform and take him prisoner. As the group's two contentious leaders, [[Bardi]] and [[Gerdis]] tried interrogating him, Andor tried insisting he was with the Rebellion and asked for Porko's whereabouts, and learned that his friend had been killed for opening fire on the group. Andor was then taken back into the TIE Avenger as his captors' only pilot, [[Rika]], tried figuring out its control system. He tried warning her against touching any instruments. Upon giving a sarcastic reply when asked how he arrived, provoking Gerdis into grabbing him, Andor insisted there was no instruction manual.<ref name="OYL" />
[[File:AndorPrisoner-OneYearLater.png|thumb|left|280x280px|Andor is taken prisoner by the Maya Pei Brigade]]
While his captors were busy bickering among themselves, Andor unsuccessfully tried convincing his guard, [[Crab (individual)|Crab]], to escape with him. He then played on his emotions, guessing his group had only arrived two days ago, as he himself had left three days prior. He then approached the group, identifying them as the [[Maya Pei Brigade]]. Learning that the Brigade had narrowly escaped an Imperial ambush and they assumed Pei to be deceased, he tried convincing them he was an ally, explaining that his group was responsible for supplying them, but refused to identify which rebel cell he belonged to; Crab tried to attack him in retaliation for being tricked but was restrained by Gerdis.<ref name="OYL" />

By nightfall, tensions amongst the Maya Pei Brigade inevitably boiled over as Crab shot Rika, resulting in the splintering into two sub-factions between Bardi and Gerdis. Andor was taken hostage by Gerdis' group and hid in the wrecked Breon HOY-39 while Bardi's faction took the TIE Avenger.<ref name="OYL" /> 

Left chained up, Andor opened his mouth for dripping rainwater as Gerdis' scout, [[Snee]] was searching the foliage between the two ships, before a blaster fight broke out forcing her back to the Breon HOY-39. As Snee informed her comrades that she found what was left of Crab's foot, leading them to presume the remains were eaten by animals, Andor interrupted them and advised they use the tarp to converse rainwater.<ref name="Sagrona" />

Come morning, Andor leaned over to drink water from a bowl as Gerdis' group took stock of their rations. As Plug suggested feeding Andor a moldy meal bar, he pointed out that Bardi's group had gone silent and advised they set up a perimeter; Gerdis defended he was about to do that, so Andor acted like it was his idea. Subsequently, Plug was sent to scout the area and he hastily returned to report that Bardi's people were working to move the TIE Avenger to train its weapons on their hideout. As his captors tried to calculate how long it would take, he responded that if Bardi was lucky, they would've shifted the starfighter about 5 meters by midnight, prompting Gerdis to order a barrage to slow their progress.<ref name="Sagrona" />

By nightfall, Gerdis and Bardi agreed to settle their turf war with [[Five Hands]] under [[Roski rules]]; the winners get Andor to fly them off planet while the losers would stay. While his guard [[Flek]] was distracted by the contest, Andor waited for the overhead thunder to mask the sound of him kicking open a compartment concealing his Bryar pistol, which he used to shoot his restraints and force Flek's silence as he bound and gagged him. Retrieving his hyperwave communicator from an overhead compartment, Andor then made his way through the trees as cover. While chaos erupted as a [[Yavinian doodar]] devoured Bardi and Gerdis with the Maya Pei Brigade firing wildly into the jungle, Andor ran back to the Avenger and killed the rebel sitting inside, before taking the starfighter into the air and departed the moon, leaving the 10 remaining survivors behind.<ref name="Sagrona" />

====Returning to Mina-Rau====
Once safely in deep space, Andor got to work hotwiring his hyperwave communicator to the Avenger's power supply, only to accidentally ignite the starboard thruster, sending him spinning out of control. After remaining upside-down for two days, he managed to get in contact with [[Kleya Marki]]. Speaking in code, he informed her that he was in transit and that he failed to make the rendezvous with Porko. When pressed for his location, a frustrated Andor vented that he couldn't fly the Avenger and asked if she or anyone else knew that, and requested a new drop-off location. Subsequently, he made his intent to call his friends on [[Mina-Rau]], only for Marki to forbade him, cryptically claiming the planet had become "crowded". Confused, he pressed her for an explanation and was told that Mina-Rau was under a frequency blockade. Fearing the worst, Andor cut off contact and plotted a course for Mina-Rau.<ref name="Harvest">{{Andor|Harvest}}</ref>

Upon arriving in orbit, Andor spotted an Imperial cruiser orbiting the planet, and proceeded to perform a nosedive through the atmosphere. Arriving the airspace over [[Council 436]], Andor spotted an [[Unidentified troop transport|Imperial troop transport]], and quickly destroyed it with a missile, causing confusion amongst a squad at the [[Mina-Rau General Store]], indirectly providing a distraction for Brasso to dash for his speeder bike. As the Imperials proceeded to open fire on Brasso, Andor responding by strafing them, eventually taking out the remaining 3 stormtroopers by destroying a grain silo and spilling its load onto them.<ref name="Harvest" />
[[File:Harvest-AltThumbnail.png|thumb|right|280px|Andor arrived on Mina-Rau]]
Spotting that Brasso's speeder had crashed, Andor proceeded to land the Avenger and ran to his friend, only to find that he had already been killed. Andor briefly held his friend in his arms before hearing Bix Caleen and Wilmon Paak calling out for him. After a moment of hesitation, he rejoined them and informed them of Brasso's demise. Realizing they couldn't stay on Mina-Rau, Andor led his friends into the Avenger and proceeded to flee the planet, leaving Brasso's body behind.<ref name="Harvest" />

====The Ghorman Assignment====

=====Undercover Mission as Varian Skye=====
In [[3 BBY]], Andor was living on Coruscant with Bix Caleen at [[Axis network safehouse|Luthen Rael's safehouse]] in [[Tomkip Towers]], and the two had rekindled their relationship. However, Caleen was still suffering from the trauma she endorsed at Dr. [[Gorst]]'s hands to the point where she had trouble sleeping and would frequently hallucinate Gorst. One such night, Andor woke up to find Caleen pointing her blaster at empty air and gently pried it from her hands before embracing her, unable to get her to open up about her trauma.<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman?">{{Andor|Ever Been to Ghorman?}}</ref>

The next day, Andor and Caleen go out to [[Samo's]], a bodega they visited the month before, to purchase food. Andor silently hung back while Caleen, passing him off as her husband, made the purchase. When they later returned to the safehouse, Caleen asked if he intended to tell Rael about the Imperial soldier he killed on their last mission. Andor replied that Rael only cared for results and rationalized that he had to kill that soldier because they were at war. But later, as they were having dinner, hearing Caleen request going out for a walk in the big park, he deemed it risky, given that the Imperial had placed cameras all over the place. They soon got into an argument over his overprotectiveness of her. When he threw back her difficulties sleeping, she retorted that she was not Maarva or Kerri and added that the whole reason he killed that Imperial soldier was because he saw her face.<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman?" />

A few nights later, Andor found Caleen awake and assumed she was seeing Gorst again, only to be passed her [[macrobinoculars]], allowing him to spot a beacon flashing a code from Rael wanting a meeting. Andor later met with Rael the next day, and was told that he was to travel to [[Ghorman]] and make contact with the [[Ghorman Front]] and perform an assessment of their leader, [[Carro Rylanz]]. Though Andor promised to think about taking the mission, Rael pointed out that the Empire was choking Ghorman so hard that even Rylanz was willing to actively oppose them.<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman?" />

Andor later visited the [[Niki-Bon Travel Agency]], who provided his alias "Varian Skye," a Coruscanti fashion designer, before traveling to Ghorman. After checking into the [[Palmo Plaza hotel|local hotel]] in [[Palmo Plaza]], he inquired with his porter, [[Thela]], about the [[Tarkin Massacre]], and apologized to the young man who painfully recalled that his father died saving him when [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] landed his cruiser and killed 500 unarmed Ghormans.<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere">{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}}</ref>

Later, while sitting at a [[Cafe|cafhouse]], Andor was approached by [[Enza Rylanz]], who had decided to make contact with him first. After exchanging pleasantries, Enza recalled how popular the cafhouse used to be before the Empire's oppression. Disappointed with the manner in which she casually approached him, Andor briefly toyed with her, suggesting that he might be an Imperial spy or a snitch looking to sell out the Ghormans for a payday and cautioned her against rushing into causes. A nervous Enza refuted that patience was a luxury when one's world isn't falling apart, adding that her father was very proud. Resuming his pleasant demeanour, Andor expressed his enthusiasm to meet with Carro and arranged to meet at the [[House of Rylanz]] next morning. As he got up to leave, he whispered to Enza that the people she had following him were merely drawing attention and advised sending them home.<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />

The next day, Andor visited the Rylanzs' [[twillery]] and met Carro Rylanz. After receiving assurances that the Ghormans sweep for listening device daily, the two men got to business. After confirming that the Front was responsible for rescuing a rebel pilot who crashed in the mountains, Andor passed Carro a special code crystal for the radio the pilot gave the Ghormans. Carro recalled corresponding with Rael but had no idea of his ally's identity. Andor maintained Rael's anonymity, saying it was for everyone's benefit.<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />

The Ghormans then told Andor of the suspected Imperial armory being constructed in [[Palmo]] and that they had been investigating its purpose, eventually gaining an inside source, whom, unknown to Andor, was Syril Karn. Responding with skepticism that they turned an Imperial to their cause, Andor suggested that their source might be feeding them false information, though [[Dilan]] insisted their source was reliable. The Ghormans then explained their plan to hijack an Imperial transport they suspected to be carrying weapons and expose the Empire's oppressive actions, but acknowledged that they lacked the tactical expertise to pull it off. Andor requested tour of Palmo at night, during which Enza and Dilan explained their plan to disable a lone [[cargo carrier]] and drop the weapon crates into the spillway to be collected by their transport.

Andor met with Carro Rylanz at the cafhouse. Hearing the Ghorman leader eager to learn if Andor was leaving to bring back reinforcements, he replied that it wasn't his decision, especially since he had more questions than recommendations. He judged that while their plan is feasible with outside support, the fact that they intend to advertise what they had done while living at the scene of the crime is a bad idea. His response earned Carro's disappointment, who departed with the bitter message to pass onto Rael that he was unimpressed with Andor.<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />

=====Tensions with Luthen Rael=====
Andor later traveled to [[Port Steergard]] to meet up with Rael, arriving late to the rendezvous as a result of a pre-flight inspection. As they traveled back to Coruscant aboard Rael's Haulcraft, Andor recommended against getting involved with the Ghorman Front. Rael responded with disappointment that Andor would just give up after spending a day on the planet, having been informed by the Ghormans of his reluctance. Andor insisted that the Ghormans weren't ready to fight the Empire and were carelessly rushing. As he explained the Ghormans' plan, he judged that it would pointless and that the Empire would crush them. Rael disagreed, believing that the potential for violence on Ghorman could galvanize the Rebel cause, and criticized Andor for thinking like a thief than a leader; Andor insisted he was thinking like a soldier and refused to get involved.<ref name="What a Festive Evening">{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}}</ref>

Andor later returned to the safehouse and reunited with Caleen, sharing an intimate kiss and embrace. As they got to talking about his mission, he learned that Rael visited her while he was away to ask for a weapons appraisal. This news upset Andor, as Rael did not disclose his meeting with Caleen.<ref name="What a Festive Evening" />

Traveling to [[Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest]], Andor confronted Rael in his shopkeeper persona for going behind his back and talking to Caleen. However, Rael, eager to get Andor to leave to avoid prying eyes, told him to leave immediately with the improvised cover story that he was returning a [[Darvian Medallion]] that Kleya Marki misplaced. As Andor questioned what was wrong with him, Rael stated this was the second time he had let him down today and that he thought it would have been more interesting if Caleen didn't tell Andor, and now they both disappointed him.<ref name="What a Festive Evening" />

Andor took offense what he viewed as Rael's self-important goals, but the spymaster asserted that "The Cause" mattered more, reminding Andor of the words he said back on Ferrix where he was given the choice to kill or recruit him, and he chose the latter. Rael further mocked him for being too soft on Ghorman yet willing to protect Caleen at any cost. Andor defended that he gave him everything, but was reminded that he was the one who recklessly risked exposing them out of anger and lack of self-control. Rael stated that Caleen had to pull herself together or risk becoming a liability. Andor retorted that his relationship with Rael worked better with Caleen left out, reminding that he joined him to be a part of something and suggested that he wanted him to keep fighting, Rael will find a way to work things out, and departed.<ref name="What a Festive Evening" />

=====Dealing with Doctor Gorst=====
The next night, Andor woke again to find Caleen out of bed, staring out the window. As she drew his attention to the signal beacon on the horizon indicating a new mission, she insisted on joining him. Turning her to face him, he agreed to bring her along.<ref name="What a Festive Evening" />
[[File:GorstGoesBoom-WaFE.png|thumb|left|265px|Cassian and Bix walk away from the explosion]]
The pair infiltrated an [[Imperial Intelligence]] facility where Dr. Gorst was heading a new Imperial interrogation programme. Caleen awaited Gorst in one of the interrogation rooms and ambushed him, leaving him strapped to the same torture device he used on her. Andor later rejoined her after she left Gorst and killed a security guard, before they blew up the building.<ref name="What a Festive Evening" />

===In the Rebellion's service===
====The Ghorman Massacre====
=====Return to Ghorman and assassination attempt=====
[[File:Messenger-AltThumbnail.png|right|thumb|265px|Cassian in his Yavin 4 room]]
In [[2 BBY]], Andor was recruited by [[General]] [[Davits Draven]],<ref name="Visual Guide" /> having chosen to leave Rael's singular cell to instead join<ref name="Jedha" /> the growing,<ref name="Welcome">{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}}</ref> formalized rebellion<ref name="Messenger">{{Andor|Messenger}}</ref> on Yavin 4.<ref name="Jedha" /> Draven became Andor's [[case officer]].<ref name="From the Shadows" 
/>

Andor and Caleen lived together on the jungle world in a treehouse not far away from the [[Great Temple|Rebel base]]. They were approached by Wilmon Paak with a mission from Rael—to assassinate ISB Supervisor [[Dedra Meero]], now stationed on Ghorman, to put an end to her hunt for Rael and the three Ferrixians present. Andor refused, believing the time for lone actions had passed. Later that night, Caleen brought Andor to [[Unidentified Force healer|the Force healer]] to treat his injured shoulder. Initially reluctant, Andor is persuaded by Caleen to visit the healer, despite his skepticism. He recalled a negative experience with a Force healer years ago, making him wary of such practices. However, Caleen insisted, arguing that his untreated blaster wound needed attention. The healer, an older woman with silver hair, immediately sensed Andor’s injury without being told, demonstrating her Force sensitivity. She gently placed her hand on his shoulder, closing her eyes as she channeled the Force. Andor, visibly uncomfortable, tried to dismiss the experience, but the healer's words strike a chord.

[[File:WhoAreYou-AltThumbnail.png|right|thumb|280px|Cassian looks at the destroyed KX Unit]]
Amid the massacre, Andor attempts to take out Meero, but his efforts are thwarted when Syril Karn unexpectedly intervenes. The two engage in a brutal fight, with Karn nearly overpowering Andor. As Karn raised Andor's own blaster rifle on him, Andor failed to recognize him, stating, "Who are you?" As a stunned Karn lowered the rifle in response, Carro Rylanz shot Karn in the head, ending the struggle. Andor, shaken but determined, escapes with Paak, witnessing the devastation left in the massacre’s wake. During his escape, Andor encounters a KX-series security droid deployed by the Empire to suppress the uprising. The droid grabs Andor by the throat and lifts him off the ground, nearly crushing him. Struggling against its grip, Andor manages to disable the droid when a Ghorman rebel Samm crashes a heavy-duty speeder into it, cutting it in half. Recognizing the potential value of the damaged droid, Andor salvages its parts. Paak stayed behind to help the remaining members of the Ghorman Front, and the sons of Ferrix bid each other farewell.<sup>[1]</sup> Cassian drove away in the speeder with the KX droid parts. Tears welled in his eyes as he listened to Dreena's emergency broadcast.<ref name="Who Are You?">{{Andor|Who Are You?}}</ref>

=====Rescue of Mon Mothma=====
Cassian headed straight from Ghorman to Coruscant, where he waited in Rael's shop alongside Kleya Marki. As Marki forged a press pass, she informed Andor of Senator Mon Mothma's plan to deliver a power speech which condemned the actions of the Emperor, and how they needed him to evacuate her afterwards. Andor took on the false identity of Ronnie Googe, a reporter, and told Marki he intended to leave the Rebellion after the job. Marki stated his job was not done, although Andor responded that he wanted to make his own decisions.<ref name="Welcome" />

The following day, Andor met with Marki and Rael at a public walkway. Rael informed Cassian of the plan following Mothma's extraction, and Cassian was surprised that Rael intended to stay on Coruscant. Rael insisted that they still worked together and cited all prior times Andor helped him, although Andor seemed to be losing trust in him.<ref name="Welcome" />
[[File:WelcometotheRebellion-AltThumbnail.png|left|thumb|280x280px|Cassian sneaks Mon Mothma out of the Senate]]
Andor mingled with reporters at the press gallery and was joined by Mothma's aide [[Erskin Semaj]], and exchanged the code phrase 'I have friends everywhere'. Andor and Semaj headed to Mothma's pod chute whilst she delivered her speech from inside the senate. The pair separated, and Andor approached Mothma under the guise of being a reporter, before using the code phrase as identification. Mothma was suspicious, and Andor revealed he was friends with Vel Sartha and was part of the Aldhani heist, before stating his own frustrations with Rael. The pair exited the turbo lift together, and were confronted by a group of reporters who Semaj attempted to send away. Organa's agents, [[Beska]] and [[Selko]] approached the pair, and Beska revealed herself to be an Imperial spy. Semaj shouted that she was a rebel spy, which gave Cassian the distraction to shoot her dead. Andor and Mothma escaped through the atrium, and left Semaj to control the crowd. Mothma was shocked, but Cassian just welcomed her to the Rebellion. Mothma's driver, Kloris, approached them as they fled down a bridge, and Cassian also shot him dead when Mothma identified him as ISB. The pair then escaped in her limousine airspeeder.<ref name="Welcome" />

Andor and Mothma arrived at the safehouse where Semaj was waiting for them. Marki arrived later and expressed surprise at Cassian's survival. He found a heavily injured Wilmon and Dreena in the bedroom, having successfully evacuated Ghorman. Mothma thanked Andor for saving her, and he said to make it worth it.<ref name="Welcome" />

Andor, Dreena, and Wilmon took a starship to Yavin IV, where he spoke to Draven. Draven expressed doubt about Dreena, but Andor reassured him that she would fit in, being a survivor of the massacre. <ref name="Welcome" />

Andor would subsequently reunite with Bix Caleen and told her of his plans to leave the Rebellion and start a new life with her. However, the next morning, Andor discovered a video recording from Caleen, stating that she could never forgive herself if she was the reason he left the Rebellion, so she chose to leave so he could remain focused on the cause with the promise to come find him once they had defeated the Galactic Empire. Andor would then race to the spaceport, only to be told that Caleen had already left<ref name="Welcome" />

Andor would subsequently preside over the reprogramming and reactivation of the KX droid he recovered, [[K-2SO]], cautiously training his blaster rifle along with several rebel troopers as he was reactivated.<ref name="Welcome" />

====Life in Rebel Intelligence====
{{Quote|Rebellions are built on hope.|Cassian Andor|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
[[File:CassianAndor-WotF.png|thumb|right|300px|Cassian Andor, Rebellion Intelligence Agent]]
Holding the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[captain]], Andor served as an [[Intelligence officer|officer]] in the Alliance's [[Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service|Intelligence branch]] which he spent most of his Alliance service in. He established a reputation as an agent who was willing to die in the name of taking down the Empire.<ref name="From the Shadows" /> He often worked alone on missions where he had little hope for backup. He was also involved in scrappy, but nevertheless vicious, battles waged for unclear goals.<ref name="Helmet Collection 56" />

Becoming a veteran [[spy]] of the Rebellion<ref name="Rogue One" /> who took on many missions that could be deemed morally questionable,<ref name="From the Shadows" /> Andor maintained a network of contacts throughout [[the galaxy]] who kept him informed about the Empire's activities.<ref name="Rogue One" /> Throughout his career as an intelligence agent, Andor also worked undercover and used several aliases<ref name="Visual Guide" /> in locations under Imperial control, taking on the dangerous tasks to secure intel on Imperial actions. During one of his missions, Andor needed to impersonate government agents on<ref name="From the Shadows" /> the planet<ref name="BMF 48">{{BuildFalconCite|48|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref> [[Ord Mantell]]. While working as one government agent, he went by the name Willix. As a senatorial contact on [[Darkknell]], he was Aach. Andor used the name Joreth Sward when he was an assistant to [[Admiral]] [[Grendreef]]. Andor also used the code name ''[[Fulcrum]]'' when he worked as a Rebel recruiter in the [[Albarrio sector]].<ref name="Visual Guide" />

He worked to recruit several new agents during that operation. Under the ''Fulcrum'' codename, he also funneled intelligence to many rebel cells. By virtue of spending so much of his service undercover in [[star system]]s that were under Imperial control, he was able to see firsthand how ruthless Imperial occupation could be towards the people they controlled, with the spy often being stationed on [[moon]]s and planets that the Empire was strip-mining. Ultimately, Andor decided to take many morally questionable options instead of doing nothing against the Empire over the course of his career. While most of his fellow undercover Rebels did not survive their own missions,<ref name="From the Shadows" /> Andor managed to survive<ref name="Rogue One" /> but recognized that his successes, like those of other agents, did not bring about major victories for the struggling rebel cells. During that time, Andor came to rely on the fact that he was following orders to justify the actions he carried out in the name of the Rebellion.<ref name="From the Shadows" />

====Mission to the F'tzner system====
{{Quote|Wookiee rescue was absolutely not in the briefing.|K-2SO|<ref name="Adventures in Wookiee-Sitting">{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|issue=3|story=Tales from Wild Space: Adventures in Wookiee-Sitting}}</ref>}}
[[File:AndorK2Wookiees-SWA-WookieeSitting.png|thumb|left|285px|Cassian taking K-2SO to Charissia to look after the three young Wookiees]]
[[K-2SO]] was modified and came under Andor's ownership,<ref name="From the Shadows" /> with the rebel spy developing a friendship with the reprogrammed droid as they continued to work together.<ref name="Rogue One" /> Following this, Andor and K-2SO were sent to the [[F'tzner system]] to undertake a [[Raid on an Imperial freighter|raid]] on an Imperial [[freighter]]. Andor used gas to trick the Empire into thinking that [[smuggler]]s stole the cargo, as smugglers were known to use gas to raid [[transport]]s. When they got to the cargo room, they found three [[Wookiee]]s named [[D'Koetaa]], [[D'Lylaa]], and [[Wyhyatt]], and took them instead of the cargo. Andor then took them to the monastery [[moon]] of [[Charissia]] in the [[Bartahn sector]]. There, he left K-2SO to look after the three Wookiees while he undertook a [[Unidentified Rebel raid|raid]], which was successful.<ref name="Adventures in Wookiee-Sitting" />

====Investigating the Aloos====
In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> Andor sent K-2 to [[Coruscant]] to infiltrate the [[Aloo family]]. The rebels believed that Imperial [[advisor]] [[Sim Aloo]] and his daughter [[Alinka Aloo|Alinka]] were collecting [[Sith artifact]]s for [[Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]]. Under the guise of a cargo droid named K-2SB, K-2SO spied on the operations until a ship he was on was stolen by the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]] and the young [[bounty hunter]] [[Mayvlin Trillick]], both of whom had been blackmailed into assisting Alinka recover an artifact from the planet [[Ushruu]]. K-2 had been tasked by Alinka to pilot the ship there, and when he communicated the situation to Andor, Andor ordered him to assist them but to recover the artifact himself and not allow it to return to the Aloos.<ref name="Mighty Chewie">''[[The Mighty Chewbacca in the Forest of Fear!]]''</ref>

===The road to Rogue One===
====A looming threat====
{{Quote|Look I have to go.''"<br />"''What kind of weapon?''"<br />"''A planet killer! That's what he called it!''"<br />"''A planet killer?|Tivik and Cassian Andor discussing intelligence on the Death Star provided by defector Bodhi Rook|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
Andor often went to great lengths to recover information about threats to the Rebellion, with the man developing a particular focus on retrieving intelligence about weapons development.<ref name="From the Shadows" /> Andor began working to surveil Imperial [[kyber crystal]] shipments, with his contacts confirming that the [[Ring of Kafrene]] was a hub for undercover Imperial transportation of the dangerous crystals. Although he could not discover the magnitude of the operation due to the fact that the Empire was using civilian ships to do the bulk of the movement, he reported the development to General Draven.<ref name="Rebel Files">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref>

[[File:MelshiAndorK2Game-Andor-WhoElseKnows.png|right|thumb|280px|Cassian played Chips with Melshi and K-2SO]]
Andor, K-2SO, and Melshi were playing a game of chips, something they did regularly, and were playfully arguing over K-2SO's predictions of their moves, when Paak suddenly interrupted them. Paak showed his [[Fractal radio]], which was banned from Yavin 4, which was receiving a transmission. Andor believed it was erroring, but Paak was insistent that someone was calling for help. Andor, Melshi, and a reluctant K-2SO decided to answer the distress call. They discovered that Kleya Marki was the one who sent the distress signal, as her identity had been revealed to the Empire. Marki revealed Luthen Rael's death, and attempted to pass on a secret message with the intention to remain behind and die. Andor promised her that Yavin 4 would accept her, but she accused him of betraying Rael due to joining the Rebel Alliance;<ref name="Who Else Knows">{{Andor|Who Else Knows?}}</ref> however, he continued to reassure her of Yavin's safety. [[Avril Heert]] and his Imperial troupes arrived to arrest and torture Marki, so Andor and Melshi fought them off. Marki was knocked unconscious, and K-2SO ultimately saved the trio when they were cornered. Andor and Melshi chose to take Marki with them to Yavin 4.<ref name="Jedha" />

Andor successfully convinced the suspicious rebels that they were also rebels and not imperials. He then admitted to Draven that he was intending to rescue Rael, who was now dead. Andor explained the secret energy project that Rael died to expose, but the council were suspicious of the lack of information, especially due to Rael's duplicitous nature. Andor was especially annoyed with [[Bail Prestor Organa]]. He visited Marki in the infirmary and apologized for the lack of a positive welcome, before he then reunited with and embraced Paak. Vel Sartha later visited Andor in his hut, where they drank revnog and Sartha toasted to the people they met in the journey. Andor toasted to Cinta Kaz after Sartha was unable. Sartha admitted to having been sent by Mothma to get confirmation on Marki's story, which Andor stated was true. When Sartha left, she advised Andor to reconnect with Caleen, as she knew where she was living, but Andor was reluctant.<ref name="Jedha" />

The next day, Andor dreamt of his sister before being woken by K-2SO. Organa visited Andor, and informed him that he was approved to confirm Marki's story by going on a [[mission to the Ring of Kafrene]]. Andor noted Organa's more positive attitude, before stating he would have got along with Rael. Organa stated "May the Force be with you". Andor walked through Yavin 4 and observed all of the people he had met and befriended throughout the years: Melshi, Paak, Dreena, Sartha, Mothma, and the Force Healer. He and K-2SO took off in their ship together.<ref name="Jedha" />

====Ring of Kafrene====
[[File:MissiontoKafrene.jpg|thumb|left|290px|Cassian and Tivik]]
Andor met with [[Tivik]]—an injured member of [[Saw Gerrera]]'s [[Partisans]]<ref name="Rogue One" /> whom Andor had turned into his contact within Gerrera's forces<ref name="Jedha" />—in [[section nine]]. Through Tivik, Andor learned<ref name="Rogue One" /> vital information<ref name="From the Shadows" /> about how the Empire had built a [[superweapon]], which his informant—a defecting cargo pilot named [[Bodhi Rook]]—described as a planet killer. As he continued to try to coax information out of Tivik, two stormtroopers advanced towards them.<ref name="Rogue One" /> The stormtroopers surrounded them,<ref name="From the Shadows" /> having become suspicious of the exchange, and the two troopers before them demanded to see [[scandoc]]s.<ref name="Rogue One" /> Despite deeming it to be a terrible moral choice, Andor realized there was a chance Tivik would be taken prisoner and interrogated until he revealed what he had told his fellow Rebel, which would mean he would need to kill the informant to protect what he had learned from getting out.<ref name="From the Shadows" />

Andor only had a few moments to consider the options before him.<ref name="From the Shadows" /> As the stormtroopers demanded answers, he feigned awkwardness before quickly drawing a blaster pistol, gunning down the two troopers. Another trooper noticed the incident and called for reinforcements to section nine. Realizing their clandestine meeting location was also a dead end, Cassian deduced the quickest escape path was to climb out, but Tivik revealed he would be unable to escape the area because of his injured arm. Although Andor calmed Tivik, he quickly decided to shoot Tivik in the back<ref name="Rogue One" /> to ensure he would not be captured by the Empire. Visibly upset but deciding to wait before he reflected on what he had done,<ref name="From the Shadows" /> Cassian stowed his pistol in his belt, left the bodies, and climbed away before more stormtroopers,<ref name="Rogue One" /> who were closing in,<ref name="From the Shadows" /> could arrive.<ref name="Rogue One" />

====A new mission====
{{Quote|Galen Erso is vital to the Empire's weapons program. Forget what you heard in there. There will be no extraction. You find him… you kill him. Then and there.|General Draven's secret orders to Cassian Andor|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
[[File:Rescue_of_Jyn_Erso-Rogue_One.png|thumb|right|330px|Andor was dispatched to Wobani to rescue Jyn Erso.]]
On orders from Mothma, Draven, and<ref name="From the Shadows" /> Senator<ref name="Rogue One" /> [[Bail Prestor Organa]], Andor took part in the [[Liberation of Erso|liberation]] of [[Jyn Erso]]<ref name="From the Shadows" /> on the [[planet]] [[Wobani]]. Erso was a former close associate of Saw Gerrera and the daughter of [[scientist]] [[Galen Walton Erso]], who had been pressed into working on the secret project Tivik had warned Andor of.<ref name="Rogue One" /> Andor had identified Erso despite being entered into the Imperial prison system underneath the alias Liana Hallik. Andor also confirmed she had operated under several under aliases.<ref name="Rebel Files" /> He was given further orders by the three Rebel leaders to help convince the younger Erso into helping them retrieve a message from Galen that had fallen into Gerrera's hands<ref name="From the Shadows" /> thanks to Rook,<ref name="Rogue One" /> as Gerrera would not be willing to work with them alone.<ref name="From the Shadows" /> Indeed, Andor was then stationed at the [[Great Temple|Rebel base]] on [[Yavin 4]] as Erso arrived at the base, having been rescued by rebel forces that included K-2SO.<ref name="Rogue One" />

During a briefing with Mothma, Draven, and Erso, Andor explained that Gerrera had the Imperial cargo pilot, who defected at the behest of Erso's father, captive before revealing that the Empire was building a planet-killing superweapon. Erso ultimately joined the mission Andor was set to led to meet with Gerrera,<ref name="Rogue One" /> with Andor's mission, according to what Erso was told, being to confirm the message was real before finding Galen, if that was possible.<ref name="From the Shadows" /> Andor was ordered to travel to the moon of [[Jedha]],<ref name="Rogue One" /> which was the last known location of the Partisans<ref name="From the Shadows" /> but also an [[Jedha insurgency|active war zone]] due to their actions. As Erso got aboard Andor's [[UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft|U-wing]], [[LMTR-20]], Andor was pulled aside by Draven, who told him to keep an [[eye]] on Erso due to her reckless and potentially volatile nature as well.<ref name="Rogue One" />

[[File:Draven-warns-Andor.png|thumb|left|330px|Draven instructs Andor to look out for reckless behavior from Jyn Erso before ordering him to kill Galen Erso.]]
Revealing there would be no extraction carried out, Draven then changed Andor's mission<ref name="Rogue One" /> with a questionable command that was designed for its ends to justify its means: while Mothma indeed hoped Gerrera could convince Galen to testify in front of the [[Imperial Senate]] to stop the superweapon's development, Andor was secretly ordered by Draven to kill Galen, who was vital to the secret weapon's completion, on sight.<ref name="From the Shadows" /> In truth, however, the weapon—known to its developers as the Death Star—was already operational. When Andor returned to the U-wing, he attempted to confiscate the [[A-180 blaster]] that Erso had armed herself with, but ultimately allowed her to keep it. They then departed to Jedha to find Gerrera<ref name="Rogue One" /> and learn more about the secret weapon the Empire was developing.<ref name="From the Shadows" />

====A brush with the Death Star====
{{Quote|There is more than one sort of prison, captain. I sense that you carry yours wherever you go.|Chirrut Îmwe, while sharing a cell with Cassian Andor|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
[[File:Andor-Tythoni-ambush.png|thumb|right|330px|Andor is present for the ambush at Tythoni Square.]]
Once they landed outside of [[Jedha City]], he and Jyn left K2 with the ship and proceeded towards the [[Temple of the Kyber]], where they would contact one of Gerrera's Partisans and request a meeting with him. Going to his various sources, the two got stuck in the middle of [[Tythoni Square]], where an Imperial patrol was [[Jedha insurgency|ambushed]] by the Partisans, attacking and causing heavy casualties on both sides. When the Imperial [[TX-225 GAVw "Occupier" combat assault tank]] destroyed a building with several of the Partisans still inside, Andor shot and killed [[Jimmon Arbmab|the tank commander]]. However, when Jyn took cover behind the tank as more stormtroopers arrived, Andor then fired on a Partisan that was about to throw a grenade at the tank, which would have killed Jyn, an act that was noticed by the other Partisans. When the last troopers were eliminated, the Partisans advanced and looted the tank of the stolen kyber. However, Imperial reinforcements, including an [[All Terrain Scout Transport|AT-ST]], soon arrived. As the fight continued, the two escaped and ran into K-2SO. However, the two were then mistaken for his prisoners and were detained by troopers.<ref name="Rogue One" />

[[File:MeltingJedhaCity-RO.png|thumb|left|330px|Jedha City is destroyed by the Death Star.]]
Just then, [[Chirrut Îmwe]] and [[Baze Malbus]] stepped in, defeating the entire group of troopers. However, as Andor and his new companions were then immediately captured by Saw's forces, with their leader, [[Benthic]], noting that Andor had killed one of their own. They were blindfolded with sacks over their heads and were taken to Saw's hideout outside the city before being thrown in cells.<ref name="Rogue One" /> Arriving at the base meant Andor had a chance to see Gerrera face-to-face.<ref name="From the Shadows" /> While imprisoned, he found the Imperial pilot Rook was imprisoned beside him and asked him of the location of Jyn's father. However, Rook, who had just been interrogated by [[Bor Gullet]], was incoherent and unable to communicate with Andor. Shortly afterward, the Death Star arrived over Jedha and fired its [[superlaser]] for the first time, targeting Jedha City. The city was instantly [[Destruction of Jedha City|annihilated]], with the destruction progressing quickly outward. Andor was able to free himself and led Îmwe, Malbus, and Rook outside as the rest of the Partisans descended into chaos as they attempted to escape the blast. Andor located Jyn and brought her outside as K2 brought the U-wing to load their crew. As the blast continued to radiate, Andor and K2 were forced to jump to hyperspace while still in atmosphere, but miraculously escaped.<ref name="Rogue One" />

[[File:ConflictedAndor.png|thumb|right|330px|Andor receives orders to continue with haste to Eadu.]]
Having learned Galen Erso was on the planet [[Eadu]], Andor contacted Draven via a coded communication, telling him "Weapon confirmed. Jedha destroyed. Mission target located on Eadu, please advise." He was advised to proceed with haste, and while they were in hyperspace, a conflicted Andor directed K2 to plot a course for Eadu. Jyn spoke up and told the group that she had seen the message from her father. She told Andor that her father had built the weapon with a trap inside it that would allow it to be destroyed. Andor asked to see the message, but it had been destroyed on Jedha. He asked Bodhi if he had seen the message, but the pilot shook his head. Andor told Jyn that there might be problems trying to convince Alliance High Command to act on her word with unverifiable evidence. Jyn demanded that he tell the Alliance that the [[Death Star plans]] were on [[Scarif]], and they could use the plans to find the way to destroy the reactor and therefore the entire station, but Andor refused as they were in the heart of Imperial territory. Jyn said that they would have to find her father so he could testify himself, and while he outwardly nodded, Andor knew that his orders were to eliminate Galen if they found him.<ref name="Rogue One" />

====Orders due on Eadu====
{{Quote|I had orders… orders that I disobeyed, but you wouldn't understand that.''"<br />"''Orders? When you know they're wrong? You might as well be a stormtrooper.|Andor and Jyn Erso, following Galen Erso's death|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
[[File:Andor-inspects-damage.png|thumb|left|330px|Andor inspects damage to the LMTR-20 after crash-landing on Eadu.]]
Despite the crew<ref name="From the Shadows" /> they had suddenly gathered,<ref name="Rogue One" /> Andor kept up the appearance that he would be rescuing the elder Erso, even though he was grappling with the moral dilemma of killing the man.<ref name="From the Shadows" /> The group arrived on Eadu, flying low and through bad weather attempting to avoid Imperial detection. After they crashed some distance away from the [[Eadu Energy Conversion Laboratory|Imperial facility]], Cassian and Rook left so that he could get in position to take out Galen, with Cassian preventing Jyn from joining them and lying to the group, saying he was simply doing reconnaissance. However, before he departed, he put his weapon in the sniper configuration, which K2 noticed and caused Jyn, Chirrut, and Baze to later follow them.<ref name="Rogue One" />

When they reached a vantage point with a view of the landing pad, Cassian sent Rook leave to find a ship to escape with. When Rook asked what Cassian would be doing, he sent Rook on his way without offering an explanation.
